exposure: receiving recommendations for screening at a postpartum visit
outcome: compliance with postpartum diabetes mellitus screening
cohort: 257 women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) between 2016 and 2017 at the Soroka Medical Center were included.
finding: The rates of postpartum DM screening for women with GDM are low, and factors such as age greater than 25, vacuum delivery, GDMA2 diagnosis, and receiving recommendations increased the likelihood of undergoing screening.
mod_finding: Vacuum-assisted delivery was significantly associated with a higher likelihood of undergoing postpartum DM screening.
